items.information: Se vais competir pela primeira vez, certifica-te que lês todas as informações em Informação Importante, Perguntas Frequentes e no Regulamento WCA. Se és associado da APS tens direito a um desconto exclusivo de 20%, sabe mais [aqui.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MaceiraOpen2026#67923-associados-aps-aps-associates) ​ If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in Important Information, the FAQ and the WCA Regulations. If you're an APS associate you can take advantage of an exclusive 20% discount, find out more [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MaceiraOpen2026#67923-associados-aps-aps-associates). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQ3NTE2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6922861b4b243d7afa178dbcd7d15956c360d756/Logo%20Maceira%20Open.png)

items.name: Wrightsville Beach Bash 2026

venue.name: Holiday Inn Resort Lumina on Wrightsville Beach by IHG
venue.address: 1706 N Lumina Ave, Wrightsville Beach, NC 28480

items.information: **All competitors must read the [Competitor Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WrightsvilleBeachBash2026#66112-competitor-information) prior to registering.** Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email. **Due to space limitations, each competitor is only allowed to bring ONE guest with them to the competition.** Yes, parents and siblings count as guests. This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing Inc](https://southeastcubing.org/about) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDM1NzIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d9cae9d8ff46f8d2ea459941cb151cadd0782269/SOUTHEAST_5%20(1).png)
